group_a_pre_rewrite_only.finding: each matches Sourcify's blob at da74452a and the other four factory-equivalent commits (and every earlier commit back to 85bd3a3), then changes exactly once, at the 2023-11-30T21:21:45Z licence-header rewrite 6164ddd4c75ef6da2181e5623b99795b9829e31c, and never changes again through head. Sourcify's copy is the pre-rewrite state, so these four require a commit strictly before 6164ddd4c75.

group_b_never_in_git.finding: constant in every reachable commit (main, all named branches, all 37 PRs) at blob 4c42cb0c2cce25d40350697c8cc0af920f1a355e and f4e164f0013dcf62206ffb75337d9dc0cf8dff77 respectively, from their introduction through head. Sourcify's copies differ from both by exactly one added line, `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`, before the pragma line; no other byte differs. A direct GitHub git/blobs lookup for Sourcify's exact blob SHA-1 on each file (bda28b6dd9f855317aeb840ddd27a36a54cbf4da, 6495118e40e87babba08b16687d306cb52c1d7e5) returned Not Found, meaning that exact content was never pushed to this repository under any reachable ref.

group_c_post_development_only.finding: the other 40 in-tree sources, including src/lens/MarketLens.sol itself, do not reach their Sourcify blob until well after da74452a (only 9 of 46 match at da74452a); errata-bugfixes-branch commits between the licence rewrite and head (e.g. 'Fix lens pollution griefing vector', 2024-01-10) are needed to reach the head-matching state

why_no_commit_reaches_46_of_46.conclusion: group A requires a commit strictly before 2023-11-30T21:21:45Z; group C requires a commit at or after 2024-01-10 (and effectively at head); no single commit satisfies both, and group B's exact content is not reachable at any commit at all. The MarketLens V1 source is therefore a source state assembled across time, not a single checkout, and 488b30d0 (40/46) is recorded as the closest identifiable single-commit reference.

equivalent_commits_deployer_checkout.finding: the factory deployed 2023-12-04T08:53:59Z, four days after all five candidates and after the licence rewrite. Main's tip at deployment time was d46ecb80 (post-rewrite), but the deployed bytecode reproduces the pre-rewrite source (da74452a state), so the deployer used a checkout that was not main's tip at deploy time. Because the five candidates are blob-identical for every file that affects the compiled output, no on-chain or git evidence can distinguish which of the five was the deployer's actual working tree; source.equivalent_commits in targets.json records all five with da74452a retained as the primary reference.
